rules.observedXBehavior: When Original X renders a video for a post with saved playable media, the Reader should render a video element rather than a static missing/placeholder surface.
rules.readerRule: Use saved X video variants through the local media proxy and render the video in the media frame.

rules.observedXBehavior: Original X commonly autoplays visible timeline/detail videos muted when the page allows playback.
rules.readerRule: Reader videos should autoplay muted inline when a playable variant exists. Playback timing can be flaky, so this rule must be backed by video facts as well as screenshots.

rules.observedXBehavior: If Original X shows attached media, the Reader should show corresponding image/video media instead of only text or links.
rules.readerRule: Preserve X media arrays and render saved media before translation and action rows.

rules.observedXBehavior: X does not expose raw t.co tokens as the primary reading experience when it can render display URLs, media, quote cards, or preview cards.
rules.readerRule: Hide media/quote status links when their rich object is rendered, and replace ordinary inline links with readable display labels.

rules.observedXBehavior: For ordinary no-media posts with several external URLs, X renders one primary external preview card rather than a stack of cards. When Original X has an external preview card, the Reader should not reduce the post to only a naked inline URL.
rules.readerRule: Render at most one primary external preview card per no-media post. Keep additional external URLs as inline display links or compact fallback chips so information is preserved without over-rendering.

rules.observedXBehavior: Original X can render x.com/i/article links as rich Article cards inside the main post or quoted post even when the API only exposes a URL entity.
rules.readerRule: Render X Article links as X-like article preview cards when structured or authenticated evidence-backed preview metadata exists. If metadata is absent, keep the sample as a fidelity failure or blocked evidence case instead of treating a raw article URL as acceptable.
